verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk-operation feature, but some evidence points in that direction. SigNoz can clone a dashboard section along with every panel inside it, and it supports managing dashboards as code or as editable JSON. Service accounts provide programmatic API access for automation scripts, and the MCP server and Agent Skills let AI agents manage dashboards and alerts, which could be scripted to act on many items. missing for 10: an explicit multi-select or batch action (e.g., bulk edit, delete, or mute) for alerts and dashboards, documented batch API endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven bulk changes.
